ns0:svg.ns0:title: Softmax Collapse and Cancellation, measured float64 kernels
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Four panels compare standard and fixed gradients to independent Decimal arithmetic. Exact zero is not replaced with a logarithmic floor. Deterministic cases, no error bars.
